approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: The patch release packages merged bug fixes using the existing release contract. Its changes cover version metadata, examples, verification fixtures and operator documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Cargo metadata and the self-built CI and Trust pins select 6.4.2. Action examples name the explicit candidate version. The installed binary default and current-install guidance select published 6.4.1 until publication. The changelog and release handoff account for user-visible fixes actually merged since v6.4.1. The version validator, workflow-pin validator, release-candidate contract tests and project gates pass on the prepared revision.
